name: @epoch/authorization
description: Epoch Authorization kernel — the typed decision point over opaque principal/tenant/resource ids: authorization requests (principal + tenant scope + resource reference + action), decisions (allow/deny/not-applicable with typed reasons and exact evidence paths), fail-closed tenant isolation (cross-tenant-denied by construction), content-addressed decision records, and a W004 policy-target projection (W009). Not a policy engine: policy evaluation is host-wired behind the typed facts interface.
